Good to plan

Feeding a party crowd.

For a kids' party, plan two menus: simple food for the children (pasta, mild chicken, finger food) and a proper meal for the adults who came with them. Children under 10 count as about half a guest. Serve food early in the party, before the games and cake.

For an evening party, decide whether guests expect a full dinner or bites and drinks: the quantities are very different. Our food per person guide has a calculator for both.

Planning a party at home? Read our guide to party catering at home in Dubai.

Questions

Good to know.

Do you cater kids' birthday parties?

Yes. We plan simple, child-friendly food for the children and a proper menu for the adults.

Do you make birthday cakes?

Tell us in your enquiry if you need a cake and the team will confirm what we can provide. Many families order the cake separately.

Can you cater a Halloween or themed party?

Yes. Tell us the theme and headcount, and we will build a menu of bites or a buffet to fit.

How much food do I need for a birthday party?

For a full meal, plan about 150 g of rice, 175 g of meat, chicken or fish, 100 g of vegetable dishes, a salad and a dessert per adult, with children under 10 counted as half.

Is your food halal?

Yes. All our catering menus are 100% halal.
